sentences.translation: When he heard that PayPay was useful, he put the app in his phone.
I managed to finish the setup, but I wasn’t confident that it was really working.
The next day, at the convenience store's cash register, the clerk said,
Are you using PayPay?” Dragon said, “Yes.
When you open the app, you’ll be asked to enter your PIN.
More people line up behind them.
Just time passed while staring at the screen.
"It's cash after all," said the dragon.
I put out my wallet and paid for it.
The clerk did not give a smile, and he responded with care.
That night, Dragon Star reconfigured the app.
I registered my bank account, charged a small amount, and paid for the test.
I thought I would never fail next time.
